name: Order Capture
desc: End-to-end stage covering all activities from initial client engagement through to project activation and budget establishment.

name: Customer & Contract Setup (incl. portal setup)
desc: Establish the client record, negotiate and execute the master services agreement, set up the client portal, and configure entitlements.

name: Customer Initiation
desc: Receive new client / opportunity trigger from Sales/Business Development. Capture preliminary customer details (name, region, industry)
data:
- Customer ID
- Parent Customer ID
- Customer Name
- Industry
link to master data if existing

name: Log Prospect in HubSpot & Create HubSpot Customer Record
desc: Create a new Contact and Company record in HubSpot. Capture preliminary details (client name, region, service line, deal scope). Duplicate detection rule runs automatically on save. If a matching Customer record exists in HubSpot, the user is prompted to merge or link the entry

name: Opportunity Created in HubSpot
desc: Convert the prospect to a HubSpot Deal. Populate deal name, estimated value, engagement type (T&M / Fixed Fee / Retainer), expected close date and pipeline stage. Assign deal owner and deal split. Complete initial qualification checklist (budget, authority, need, timeline) to confirm pursuit

name: Advance Prospect Through Deal Stages
desc: When the prospect is being actively pursued, the user should advance the Deal Stage through the various stages (RFP/Proposal Submitted > Pitch > Negotiation > Verbal Award > Contracting

name: Customer Already Exists in ERP?
desc: Determine whether the customer already exists in ERP. The 'Verbal Award' stage automatically triggers a check if Customer already exists in ERP master data (e.g., if Oracle/Maconomy Customer ID is blank), and initiates MDM setup workflow where required
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.1.4 | No – proceed to 1.1.1.5

name: Submit Request to Global Master Data Team
desc: HubSpot Workflow automatically opens a ServiceNow ticket to the Global Master Data team without any action from the end user. The ticket is pre-populated with all client fields already captured in HubSpot

name: Customer Master Data Creation & Hierarchy Setup
desc: Create customer record in CRM/ERP (e.g., legal entity name, billing address, VAT number, etc.). Perform duplicate check. Assign customer ID and account owner. Define parent/child relationships if applicable (e.g., billing entity). Link back to prospect opportunity in HubSpot

name: MDM Ticket Review & Identification of Data Gaps.
desc: ServiceNow ticket is routed with client fields pre-populated from HubSpot, to be reviewed for accuracy/completeness. Identify which ERP-specific fields can be completed independently (e.g., internal segmentation codes) and which require commercial input from Client Services

name: Is Client Services Input Required to Complete Missing Fields?
desc: Determine whether Client Services is required to fill out missing Customer data fields
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.1.2.3 | No – proceed to 1.1.3

name: Request for Supplementary Information
desc: MDM initiates request for supplementary information via a structured follow-up task in the ServiceNow ticket, and is routed to Client Services for action

name: Obtain & Populate Missing Information for Customer Record
desc: Client Services reaches out to Customer for missing information, completes the task directly within ServiceNow (or via a linked HubSpot task if the ServiceNow–HubSpot integration is active) and submits

name: MDM Ticket Review & Record Creation
desc: MDM team is notified automatically on submission and proceeds to Oracle/Maconomy record creation

name: Ticket Closure & Customer ID Write-back
desc: ServiceNow ticket is automatically closed upon record creation. Ticket closure triggers an automated write-back of the Oracle/Maconomy Customer ID to the HubSpot Company record via the ServiceNow–HubSpot integration

name: Notification of Client Record Update in HubSpot
desc: Client Services receives HubSpot notification that the customer record is live and the Oracle/Maconomy Customer ID is populated

name: Credit & Compliance Screening
desc: Perform credit check (incl. credit holds) / financial due diligence. Conduct compliance checks. Assign provisional payment terms and risk rating

name: Compliance Screening
desc: Perform regulatory and policy checks including sanctions, AML, watchlist, etc. to ensure the relationship is permissible before extending credit.
sys: Assumes third party provider is used

name: Credit Assessment
desc: Review the prospective customer’s financial standing using payment history, trade references, credit bureau data, financial statements and existing exposure to evaluate overall creditworthiness
sys: Assumes third party provider is used

name: Risk Scoring
desc: Apply defined scoring models or risk rules to convert assessment inputs into a standardised credit risk score
sys: Credit platform or equivalent workflow tool

name: Credit Decisioning
desc: Determine credit outcome based on scoring thresholds and policy rules (e.g., approve, escalate for manual review, reject)
sys: Credit platform or equivalent workflow tool

name: ERP Credit Master Update
desc: Automatically interface approved credit decisions from credit platform/workflow tool to ERP (Oracle/Maconomy) to update customer credit master data, payment terms and hold status

name: Notify Stakeholders
desc: Automatically notify relevant teams
sys: Credit platform or equivalent workflow tool

name: Master Services Agreement (MSA) management
desc: Check for existing MSA and validate applicability. Draft MSA (if required) using standard templates.  Negotiate legal and high-level commercial terms. Execute agreement (signatures). Store in contract repository and link to customer record

name: Existing MSA Check
desc: Determine whether a valid MSA already exists for the customer or parent/affiliate group
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.1.4.11 | No – proceed to 1.1.4.2

name: Select MSA Template
desc: Choose the appropriate MSA template from CLM based on division, commercial model, client region, etc.

name: Populate High-level Commercial Terms
desc: Enter high-level commercial details including commercial model, rate card, agreed discount, payment terms (e.g. Net 30), currency and billing frequency into the contract template

name: Non-Standard Terms?
desc: Determine whether any negotiated terms deviate from global policy (e.g., standard terms, payment milestones)
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.1.4.5 | No – proceed to 1.1.4.6

name: Send Contract to Client
desc: Transmit final contract to client signatories via e-signature link within HubSpot (via DocuSign integration)

name: Client Amendments
desc: Determine whether the customer has proposed amendments to the contract
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.1.4.3 | No – proceed to 1.1.4.8

name: Client Reviews & Signs Contract
desc: Client reviews the contract, raises redlines if applicable and executes e-signature within HubSpot (via DocuSign integration)

name: Contract Fully Executed?
desc: Confirm that all counterparty signatures are captured and the contract is legally binding before proceeding. Change document status to "Completed"
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.1.4.10 | No – proceed to 1.1.4.6

name: Set Up Client Portal & Entitlements
desc: Provision the client's portal access, configure project visibility, set user roles and permissions and confirm with the client that access is working

name: Notify Stakeholders
desc: "Completed" status triggers workflow for automated internal handoff notifications to relevant stakeholders

name: MSA Upload to Agent
desc: Automatic upload MSA document to Contract Capture Tool [still to be defined]

name: MSA: Data Extraction
desc: Extract and structure key customer, commercial and contractual data from the MSA to support project setup. Flag whether document is New or Amended. Link to parent MSA, if applicable. Automatically capture data extractions and feed into PSA or ERP
sys: Contract Capture Tool / PSA or ERP

name: Order Entry & Validation (incl. POs)
desc: Execute Statement of Work (SOW) incl. scope, deliverables, and pricing. Set up the contract/order in the ERP system and prepare for project setup

name: SOW initiation / amendment
desc: Receive new project opportunity (following 1.1.4.11 for new customers; point of origination for existing customers)

name: Project Amendment?
desc: Determine whether scope is related to an existing project and requires amendment to the SOW
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.2.2.2 | No – proceed to 1.2.2.1

name: Draft SOW
desc: Develop scope, deliverables and timelines. Define pricing and commercial terms. Align resourcing and effort with delivery. Generate SOW document

name: Select SOW Template (CLM)
desc: Choose the appropriate SOW template from PSA based on division, commercial model, project type, etc.

name: Define Scope & Delivery Approach
desc: Establish deliverables, timeline, milestones, dependencies, etc.

name: Define Pricing & Commercial Terms
desc: Determine pricing model, fees, billing structure and key commercial terms. Define billable vs. non-billable guidelines
data:
- Fees
- Pricing Strucure
- Billing cadence
- Billing triggers

name: Define Resourcing & Effort
desc: Define resourcing and effort requirements to support delivery

name: Draft SOW Document
desc: Generate and populate SOW document using standardised templates

name: Scope Change?
desc: Determine whether there is a scope change after initial SOW draft
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.2.2.7 | No – proceed to 1.2.3

name: Redraft SOW Document
desc: Redraft and update the SOW to reflect approved scope changes (e.g., scope, pricing, timelines, deliverables)

name: Send SOW to Client
desc: Transmit final SOW to client signatories via e-signature link within HubSpot (via DocuSign integration)

name: Client Reviews & Signs Contract
desc: Review and redline with customer. Finalise SOW details and obtain e-signature

name: Send Contract to Client
desc: Transmit final SOW to client signatories via e-signature link within HubSpot (via DocuSign integration)

name: Client Amendments
desc: Determine whether the customer has proposed amendments to the SOW

name: Client Reviews & Signs SOW
desc: Client reviews the SOW, raises redlines if applicable and executes e-signature within HubSpot (via DocuSign integration)

name: Contract Fully Executed?
desc: Confirm that all counterparty signatures are captured and the contract is legally binding before proceeding. Change document status to "Completed"

name: Project Activation Trigger
desc: "Completed" status triggers workflow for new project activation in PSA (or project updates if this is an amendment to an existing project scope)

name: SOW Internal Approval
desc: Route SOW for final approval and signatures. Check for existing credit holds

name: SOW Upload to Agent
desc: Automatic upload SOW document to Contract Capture Tool [still to be defined]

name: SOW: Data Extraction
desc: Extract and structure key scope, pricing and billing data from the SOW to support project setup, revenue recognition and invoicing process. Flag whether document is New or Amended. Link to parent SOW, if applicable. Automatically capture data extractions and feed into PSA or ERP
sys: Contract Capture Tool / PSA or ERP

name: SOW Alignment to MSA?
desc: Determine if SOW aligns with agreed MSA (scope alignment to services framework, pricing structure, payment terms, etc.)
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.2.3 | No – proceed to 1.2.2.7

name: SOW Alignment Discrepancy Resolution
desc: Identify and resolve discrepancies (e.g., inconsistencies with billing terms). Update SOW document where required

name: SOW Value Capture & System Recording
desc: Capture agreed SOW value and commercial terms in ERP during contract/order setup. Ensure SOW value is recorded as the basis for billing and revenue recognition

name: PO Intake, Validation & Routing
desc: Receive purchase order (PO) from client. Validate PO details against SOW (value, scope, entity, dates). Route PO internally for review. Record and link PO to customer / contract

name: PO Received?
desc: Determine whether PO has been received
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 1.2.5.2 | No – proceed to 1.2.6

name: PO Intake
desc: Automatically receives purchase order (PO) from client via agreed channel(s) (e.g., email, portal, EDI)

name: PO Upload to Agent
desc: PO automatically uploaded to Contract Capture tool when submitted via agreed channel [still to be defined]

name: PO: Data Extraction
desc: Extract and structure key purchase order data (e.g., PO number, value, billing entity, dates) to support contract setup and invoicing. Flag whether document is New or Amended. Link to related POs, if applicable. Automatically capture data extractions and feed into PSA tool

name: PO Completeness & Validity Check
desc: Verify PO includes required details (e.g., PO number, value, dates, client entity). Confirm PO is valid and approved on client side

name: PO Alignment to SOW?
desc: Determine if PO aligns with agreed SOW (scope, value, billing structure, and deliverables) and MSA terms where applicable
outcomes: Yes – proceed to step 1.2.5.6 | No – proceed to 1.2.5.5

name: PO Alignment Discrepancy Resolution
desc: Identify and resolve discrepancies (e.g., inconsistencies with billing terms). Request PO corrections where required and reupload to Contract Capture tool

name: PO Capture & System Linkage
desc: Automatically link PO to customer and opportunity

name: Contract setup / order entry
desc: Create contract/order record in ERP. Input pricing, billing structure and key terms. Link to customer. Associate PO to contract/order. Configure billing schedule and triggers. Set revenue recognition method.
data:
- Deliverables
- Timeline
- Milestones
- Dependencies
- Fees
- Pricing Strucure
- Billing cadence
- Billing triggers
- Resourcing
- Revenue recognition method

name: Contract / Order Record Creation
desc: Create contract/order record in ERP linked to customer and opportunity

name: Commercial Data Entry
desc: Input pricing, billing structure and key commercial terms based on SOW and MSA [still to be defined]

name: PO Association
desc: Link validated client PO to contract/order for billing reference, if applicable

name: Billing Configuration
desc: Configure billing schedule, triggers and invoicing parameters [still to be defined]

name: Revenue Recognition Setup
desc: Define revenue recognition method and rules aligned to contract terms

name: Data Validation & Reconciliation
desc: Validate accuracy and completeness of contract data in ERP. Confirm alignment with SOW, MSA, and PO

name: Update Deal Stage
desc: Update deal stage in CRM to "Contracted"

name: Project Activation & Budgeting
desc: Create and structure the project in the PSA aligned to the executed SOW (and PO, if applicable). Establish budgets, assign resources and configure time, expense and billing readiness. Activate the project to enable delivery, tracking and invoicing

name: Project initiation
desc: Signed SOW pre-loaded into PSA via Contract Capture tool. Assign project manager

name: Project structure setup
desc: Create project record linked to SOW, PO and customer data. Define work package (phases, activities, timeline, milestones) aligned to SOW

name: Budget setup
desc: Load revenue baseline from SOW and PO. Define cost budget based on resourcing plan. Establish margin baseline

name: Initial resourcing alignment
desc: Validate roles and capacity assumptions against SOW. Initiate coordination with resource management for staffing requirements

name: Time & expense enablement
desc: Enable time entry against project. Configure expense policies and categories. Validate billable vs non-billable guidelines. Load and synchronise project codes to expense systems (e.g., Concur)

name: Billing readiness validation
desc: Confirm billing configuration is correctly linked to project. Validate invoice triggers and schedule alignment. Ensure bill-to details and client data are correct

name: Project governance & controls setup
desc: Define reporting cadence (status, financials). Establish change control process. Define approval matrix (timesheets, expenses, etc.)

name: Project activation (go-live)
desc: Validate all setup components are complete. Confirm no credit holds. Activate project for time, cost and billing. Notify stakeholders (Delivery, Finance, Sales)

name: Demand & Supply Planning
desc: End-to-end stage to forecast revenue demand, plan workforce capacity and assign resources to engagements to ensure optimal utilisation and delivery readiness

name: Revenue Forecasting
desc: Develop and maintain revenue forecasts based on pipeline, active contracts, historical patterns and delivery progress to produce a forward-looking demand forecast

name: Pipeline Review & Demand Signal Capture
desc: Capture and update opportunity pipeline data from CRM (e.g., HubSpot) into Divisional forecasting model, including awarded-but-not-yet-started contracts and renewals

name: Pipeline Data Review & Update
desc: Review and update opportunity data in CRM (stage, probability, value, timing) to reflect latest client engagement status

name: Opportunity Qualification for Forecast
desc: Identify opportunities for inclusion in forecast based on deal stage, probability and expected close date. "Negotiation" deal stage included in forecast Pipeline; "Verbal Award" and "Contracted" included in Committed forecast

name: Forecast Inclusion Trigger
desc: When deal stage is updated to "Negotiation", "Verbal Award" and "Contracted", opportunity data is automatically captured in division forecast in Forecast Tool

name: Pipeline Commitment & Override
desc: Review system-generated forecast and adjust opportunities based on delivery confidence. Submit pipeline and committed forecast view

name: Historical Demand Analysis
desc: Analyse historical utilisation, seasonal patterns and service-line trends to calibrate baseline demand assumptions

name: Historical Revenue & Utilisation Review
desc: Review prior period revenue and utilisation performance to establish baseline demand

name: Trend & Seasonality Analysis
desc: Analyse revenue trends and seasonal patterns by agency, engagement types, commercial model, region, etc.

name: Baseline Demand Assumption Update
desc: Update baseline demand assumptions based on historical performance and trends

name: Demand Consolidation & Forecast Generation
desc: Consolidate individual forecasts into a global demand forecast by division/agency, geography and time period. Align assumptions on timing, probability and revenue recognition

name: Forecast Consolidation
desc: Auto-consolidate pipeline, contracted revenue, renewals and historical demand inputs in Forecast Tool by division/agency, geography and period

name: Forecast Review & Challenge
desc: Review consolidated forecast (incl. variance from prior period) and challenge where appropriate

name: Forecast Finalisation & Publication
desc: Finalise and publish forecast version for downstream demand and workforce planning

name: Scope Change?
desc: Determine whether there is a scope change after initial project / forecast setup
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 2.1.5 | No – proceed to 2.2

name: Scope Change Impact Assessment
desc: Assess impact of approved scope changes on revenue forecast (e.g., value, timing, duration). Update forecast inputs and assumptions accordingly

name: Demand Planning & Workforce Optimisation
desc: Assess current and projected resource capacity against forecasted demand to identify staffing / skills requirements, and optimise workforce plans to meet expected delivery needs

name: Demand Signal Identification
desc: Translate forecasted revenue and pipeline into demand for roles, skills and capacity

name: Capacity Assessment
desc: Assess current workforce capacity, availability and utilisation levels to establish the available capacity baseline

name: Gap Analysis
desc: Compare forecasted demand against available capacity to identify shortfalls or surplus by role, skill, geography and time period

name: Hiring & Subcontractor Planning
desc: Develop plans to address gaps (e.g., hiring, redeployment, subcontracting). Optimise resource mix to balance utilisation and delivery requirements

name: Scope change?
desc: Determine whether there is a scope change after initial project / forecast setup
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 2.2.6 | No – proceed to 2.3

name: Demand Reassessment & Workforce Rebalancing
desc: Reassess demand for roles and skills based on updated forecast and approved scope changes. Reevaluate capacity and identify changes to gaps or surpluses. Adjust workforce plans (e.g., hiring, redeployment, subcontracting) accordingly

name: Staffing and Assignments
desc: Match available and planned resources to forecasted demand, and confirm resource commitments for upcoming engagements

name: Resource Matching & Assignment Proposals
desc: Match available resources to upcoming project requirements based on skills, availability, location and cost rate

name: Conflict Resolution & Prioritisation
desc: Resolve resource allocation conflicts across competing projects. Prioritise based on strategic value, contractual commitments and margin impact

name: Resource Commitment Confirmation
desc: Confirm resource assignments with project managers and resource owners. Update PSA with confirmed allocations

name: Supply-Demand Reporting
desc: Produce and distribute supply-demand summary reports to leadership. Highlight utilisation, key risks, capacity constraints and mitigation actions

name: Scope Change?
desc: Determine whether there is a scope change after initial project / forecast setup
outcomes: No – proceed to 3.1

name: Staffing Adjustment & Reassignment
desc: Reassess resource requirements based on updated scope and forecast. Adjust resource assignments, allocations or staffing plans as required

name: Service Delivery
desc: All operational activities performed during project execution: time capture, expense management, cost allocation and milestone / progress monitoring. Feeds directly into revenue recognition and invoicing.

name: Track Time
desc: Capture and approve time worked on projects to enable accurate cost tracking, billing and revenue recognition

name: Time Entry Capture
desc: Record time worked against project tasks, activities and billing category (e.g., billable, non-billable, internal) using only pre-loaded project codes that the individual is approved to charge time against

name: Timesheet Submitted?
desc: Determine whether timesheet was submitted timely and complete
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 3.1.4 | No – proceed to 3.1.3

name: Missing Timesheet Reminder
desc: Automated email reminder is sent for missing timesheet after submission deadline

name: Timesheet Review & Approval
desc: Project Manager (PM) reviews submitted time for accuracy and completeness. Approves or rejects with comments

name: PM Approval Decision
desc: Determine whether submitted timesheet is approved
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 3.1.6 | No – proceed to 3.1.1

name: Timesheet Posting & Update
desc: Approved timesheet is locked in PSA and actuals are posted to the ERP project ledger. Billable hours are flagged as available for revenue recognition and invoicing runs

name: Notify Revenue & Billing Teams
desc: PSA triggers automated notification to Revenue Accounting and Billing that approved billable hours are available for the current period rev rec and invoicing cycles

name: Timesheet Adjustment Required?
desc: Determine whether a submitted timesheet needs to be reopened for corrections
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 3.1.9 | No – proceed to 3.2

name: Process Timesheet Adjustments
desc: Correct submitted or posted timesheets after approval where changes are required due to missing, incorrect or miscoded time entries

name: Track Expenses
desc: Capture, validate and approve project-related expenses incurred by resources. Approved expenses are posted to the project cost ledger and passed to billing for client recharge where contractually permitted.

name: Expense Capture
desc: Record project-related expenses with supporting documentation, using only pre-loaded project codes that the individual is approved to charge expenses against

name: Expense Review & Approval
desc: Project Manager (PM) reviews expenses for policy compliance and accuracy. Approves or rejects expense claims with comments

name: PM Approval Decision
desc: Determine whether submitted expense report is approved
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 3.2.4 | No – proceed to 3.2.1

name: Post to Project Cost Ledger & Flag for Billing
desc: Post approved expenses to the system. Update project financial records. Rechargeable items automatically flagged for inclusion in next client invoice run. Non-rechargeable items posted to internal cost centre
data: - Billable and non-bilable out of pocket expenses

name: Track & Allocate Other Costs
desc: Capture and allocate project costs not sourced from timesheets or expense claims (e.g., overheads, sub-contractor invoices, software / tooling licences,  internal shared service allocations, etc.)

name: Cost Identification & Capture
desc: Identify other project-related costs (e.g., subcontractors, overhead allocations). Capture cost details from source systems or inputs

name: Identify Cost Source & Data Capture
desc: Identify project-related costs from source systems or inputs (e.g., vendor invoices, internal charges, licences) and capture in ERP

name: Validate Cost Accuracy
desc: Validate cost data for completeness and accuracy

name: Assign Cost Classification
desc: Assign / validate cost category (e.g., subcontractor, overhead, internal allocation)

name: Cost Allocation
desc: Apply agreed allocation methodology for shared costs (e.g. platform licences, shared tooling, internal IT support) across active projects

name: Allocation Basis Definition
desc: Define cost allocation basis (e.g., usage, headcount, revenue share, fixed split)

name: Allocation Calculation
desc: Automatically calculate cost allocation across projects based on defined rules

name: Cost Allocation Assignment
desc: Allocate costs to the appropriate project, task or cost object

name: Allocation Validation
desc: Validate allocation results for accuracy and completeness

name: Cost Allocation Approval?
desc: Determine whether cost allocations are approved for posting
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 3.3.3.1 | No – proceed to 3.3.2.1

name: Cost Posting
desc: Allocate costs to the appropriate project or activity. Post allocated costs in the ERP to project financials. Update project cost records and enable downstream reporting

name: Cost Posting to Project Ledger
desc: Automatically post allocated costs to project financials in ERP and update project cost balances

name: Cost Synchronisation to PSA
desc: Automatically sync posted costs from ERP to PSA for project tracking

name: Milestone & Progress Monitoring
desc: Monitor project progress and milestone completion to support delivery tracking, billing triggers and revenue recognition

name: Progress Tracking
desc: Track project progress against defined milestones and deliverables. Update task completion status and percentage-complete in PSA. System recalculates forecast-to-complete and estimated completion date.

name: Percentage of Completion (PoC) Update
desc: Update task, phase, milestone and project PoC in PSA based on latest delivery progress

name: Forecast-to-Complete Calculation
desc: Calculate forecast-to-complete based on project progress, milestone status and remaining effort

name: Milestone Validation
desc: Confirm milestone completion and obtain required approvals or sign-off

name: Milestone Completion Confirmed?
desc: Confirm that milestone deliverables have been completed in line with agreed scope and acceptance criteria
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 3.4.2.2 | No – proceed to 3.4.1.1

name: Prepare Milestone Completion Evidence
desc: Compile supporting documentation (e.g., deliverables, sign-offs, acceptance records). Ensure evidence is complete and aligned with contractual requirements

name: Submit Deliverables For Client Review
desc: Share deliverables and supporting evidence with client for review

name: Client Acceptance Obtained?
desc: Determine whether client has formally accepted milestone deliverables. Capture approval or identify next steps to achieve acceptance
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 3.4.2.5 | No – proceed to 3.4.1.1

name: Client Acceptance Confirmation
desc: Record client acceptance and supporting sign-off evidence

name: Progress & Milestone Update
desc: PM marks milestone as complete and accepted in PSA

name: Trigger Billing Event
desc: System automatically creates billing event and notifies the Billing team to generate the invoice. Updates revenue recognition schedule.

name: Billing Trigger Condition Met?
desc: Automatically determine whether milestone completion, PoC update or time elapsed meets billing trigger conditions
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 3.4.4.2 | No – proceed to 3.4.1.1

name: Billing Event Creation
desc: Automatically create billing event based on milestone completion, accepted deliverable, PoC billing or time elapsed trigger

name: Billing Notification Triggered
desc: Automatically notify Billing team of billable milestone or progress event

name: Revenue Recognition
desc: All activities to recognise revenue in accordance with revenue recognition rules, posting adjustments and reconcile deferred / accrued balances

name: Revenue Execution & Posting
desc: Calculate revenue based on contract terms/milestones and post journal entries to the GL

name: Revenue Recognition Trigger Initiation
desc: Trigger revenue recognition cycle (e.g., period-end). Validate alignment with SOW / MSA terms and revenue recognition rules

name: Initiate Period-End Revenue Cycle
desc: Trigger month-end revenue recognition process based on financial close calendar. Confirm cut-off dates and deadlines

name: Identify Revenue Recognition Method by Project
desc: Determine applicable revenue recognition method per project: T&M (time-earned), Fixed Fee (PoC), Milestone (delivery event), Passthrough (cost incurred), etc.

name: Revenue Treatment Routing
desc: Route transactions to appropriate revenue calculation logic based on method

name: Revenue Readiness Validation
desc: Confirm required inputs are complete (e.g., approved timesheets, cross-check fixed fee to POC, etc.)

name: T&M: Validate Approved Timecards & Rates
desc: For T&M projects, confirm all timecards for the period are approved and contracted rates are correctly applied. Reconcile billable hours.

name: Fixed Fee / Milestone: Validate POC / Milestone Progress
desc: For Fixed Fee projects, cross-check percentage of completion against project deliverables and SOW terms. For milestone-based, confirm delivery acceptance status.

name: Validate Passthrough & Third-Party Costs
desc: Confirm passthrough costs (expenses, subcontractor, market research) are approved and matched to revenue recognition treatment per contract

name: Exceptions Identified?
desc: Determine whether there is missing, incomplete or inconsistent data (e.g., timing differences)
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 4.1.4 | No – proceed to 4.1.5

name: Exception Resolution
desc: Resolve identified exceptions

name: Investigate Revenue Exception
desc: Identify root cause of exception: missing timecard, unapproved expense, incorrect PC, rate mismatch, contract term ambiguity, etc.

name: Resolve Missing or Incorrect Data
desc: Obtain missing data (e.g. late timecards, expense approvals, POC updates) or correct erroneous inputs. Coordinate with operations and delivery

name: Obtain Re-Approval if Required
desc: Where corrections change revenue amounts or treatment, obtain re-approval from appropriate authority before proceeding

name: Revenue Execution (incl. Accruals & Deferrals)
desc: Revenue is calculated according to revenue recognition rules aligned to contract terms. Includes accruals (revenue earned but not billed) and deferrals (revenue billed but not yet earned)

name: T&M: Calculate Revenue from Approved Time
desc: For T&M projects, calculate revenue as approved billable hours × contracted rates. Include any rate adjustments, discounts or cap provisions

name: Fixed Fee: Calculate Revenue from POC
desc: For Fixed Fee projects, calculate revenue based on percentage of completion. Determine earned vs unearned revenue

name: Milestone-Based: Recognise Revenue on Delivery
desc: For milestone-based projects, recognise revenue when milestone deliverables are accepted. Confirm delivery acceptance before recognition

name: Calculate Passthrough Revenue
desc: Recognise revenue for passthrough costs (expenses, subcontractor, market research) based on contract terms — either at cost or with margin

name: Calculate Accrued & Deferred Revenue
desc: Calculate period-end accruals (revenue earned but not yet billed) and deferrals (revenue billed but not yet earned). Ensure correct balance sheet treatment.

name: Journal Entry Preparation & Routing
desc: Prepare revenue journal entries based on revenue calculations. Route journal entries for approval in line with financial controls

name: Prepare Revenue Journal Entries
desc: Prepare revenue journal entries for earned revenue, accruals, deferrals and unbilled AR movements based on calculated outputs

name: Route Journals for Approval
desc: Submit journal entries for review and approval per financial controls and delegation of authority

name: Journal Entry Approvals
desc: Review and approve journal entries in line with financial controls

name: Journal Entry Review & Approval
desc: Review journal entries for accuracy, completeness and compliance with revenue recognition policy. Approve or reject with comments

name: Journal Approved?
desc: Determine whether journal entry is approved for posting. If journal is rejected, return to preparer with rejection reason
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 4.1.8 | No – proceed to 4.1.6.1

name: Revenue Posting
desc: Post revenue journal entries to the general ledger. System updates deferred revenue, accrued revenue and unbilled AR balances accordingly

name: Journal Entry Posting
desc: Post approved revenue journal entries to the GL. System updates revenue accounts

name: Deferred / Accrued Balance Update
desc: Update balance sheet accounts for deferred revenue, accrued revenue and unbilled AR based on posted journals

name: Revenue-to-Billing Reconciliation
desc: Reconcile recognised revenue against billed revenue for the period. Identify and explain any differences (timing, scope, adjustments)

name: Adjustments & True-Ups (e.g. Rebates)
desc: Process post-recognition adjustments and true-ups to reflect updated commercial or financial information (e.g., rebates, contract modifications, scope changes, etc.)

name: Adjustment Trigger Initiated
desc: Identify events requiring revenue adjustment or true-up (e.g., rebates, credits, pricing changes, change orders, etc.

name: Identify Adjustment Event
desc: Identify events requiring revenue adjustment or true-up (e.g., rebates, credits, pricing or scope changes, change orders, etc.

name: Adjustment Request Logging
desc: Record adjustment request, classify adjustment (rebate, credit, pricing change, change order) and determine appropriate accounting treatment (revenue reversal, reclass, true-up)

name: Adjustment Review And Validation
desc: Review the nature, amount and rationale for the adjustment. Validate supporting documentation and approvals. Document rationale in ERP

name: Review Supporting Documentation
desc: Review supporting documentation and approvals for the adjustment

name: Adjustment Validation
desc: Validate adjustment against contract terms and prior postings. Confirm adjustment has been commercially approved by the appropriate authority (e.g. commercial finance, key account owner)

name: Rationale Documentation
desc: Document adjustment rationale and approval trail

name: Adjustment Calculation
desc: Calculate the financial impact of the adjustment or true-up. Determine the required accounting treatment

name: Financial Impact Calculation
desc: Calculate financial impact of the adjustment. Determine revenue reversal, reclass or true-up amount

name: Determine Accounting Treatment
desc: Determine correct accounting treatment: revenue reversal, reclass between periods, true-up against accruals/deferrals, rebate or write-off

name: Journal Entry Preparation & Routing
desc: Prepare revenue journal entries based on adjustment or true-up calculations. Route journal entries for approval in line with financial controls

name: Prepare Adjustment Journal Entries
desc: Prepare journal entries based on adjustment calculations

name: Route Adjustment Journals for Approval
desc: Route journal entries for approval in line with financial controls

name: Journal Entry Review
desc: Review journal entries for accuracy and completeness

name: Journal Entry Approval
desc: Approve journal entries in line with financial controls

name: Adjustment Posting
desc: Post adjustment or true-up journal entries to the general ledger. Update project and financial records accordingly. Systematic update to revenue forecast.

name: Journal Entry Posting
desc: Post approved adjustment journal entries to the GL. Update revenue and balance sheet accounts

name: Financial Record Update
desc: Update project financial records to reflect the adjustment

name: Forecast Update Trigger
desc: Trigger update to revenue forecast based on adjustment

name: Invoicing & Billing
desc: End-to-end process to prepare, review, approve, and issue client invoices engagements including client review cycles

name: Invoice Preparation & Internal Review (incl. Billing on Behalf)
desc: Generate draft invoices from ERP based on approved timesheets, expenses or milestone triggers. Perform internal quality review before sending to client.

name: Invoice Trigger Initiated
desc: Trigger invoice cycle based on defined billing events (e.g., scheduled billing date, milestone completion, billable activity, pre-billing, etc.)

name: Billing Readiness Validation
desc: Confirm trigger conditions are met (e.g., approved time/expenses, milestone sign-off). Validate data completeness and accuracy for billing. Ensure alignment with billing structure in SOW / MSA terms

name: Mismatch Identified?
desc: Identify discrepancies between billing data and contract terms (e.g., rates, quantities, milestones). Route mismatches for resolution

name: Mismatch Resolution
desc: Investigate and resolve discrepancies (e.g., correct time/expenses, update billing data, clarify scope)

name: Billing Data Preparation & Consolidation
desc: Compile billable items (time, expenses, milestones). Generate and structure billing data, including consolidation across projects (parent-billing) or division (central billing), as required

name: Invoice Preparation
desc: Generate draft invoice with PO reference(s) and final structure

name: Internal Review
desc:
Review invoice for accuracy and completeness
Compare against approved SOW and MSA terms. Resolve discrepancies prior to client submission

name: Handoff to Operations
desc: Handoff to Operations for client review

name: Client Review & Approval
desc: Facilitate client review of draft invoice, resolve queries and obtain approval

name: Transmit Invoice to Client
desc: Submit draft invoice to client if required (e.g., skip step if scheduled billing)

name: Client Query Raised?
desc: Monitor for client response within agreed SLA

name: Client Query Resolution
desc: Address client queries or disputes. Provide supporting documentation or revise invoice as required

name: Client Approval
desc: Obtain client approval to proceed with invoice issuance. Trigger AR posting

name: Execution & Submission
desc: Finalise and issue invoice, post accounts receivable and update billing records to enable tracking and collection

name: Finalise Invoice
desc: Post finalised invoice to AR sub-ledger. System generates AR aging entry and updates deferred/unbilled revenue balances. Confirm GL impact is correct.

name: Invoice Submission to Client
desc: Issue invoice to client via email, client portal, etc.

name: Reconciliation
desc: Perform billing reconciliations (e.g., from parent billing level to sub-project level, from central billing level to project-level by division)

name: Collections
desc: All activities to collect outstanding AR, manage overdue accounts, reconcile receipts, and forecast cash

name: Reconciliation & Analysis
desc: Maintain an accurate, up-to-date AR ledger. Reconcile cash receipts to invoices, identify unapplied cash, and produce aging analysis for management review

name: Run AR Aging Report
desc: Generate aging report from ERP and identify outstanding balances by client, due date, and days overdue

name: Generate AR Aging Report from ERP
desc: Generate AR aging report showing outstanding invoices by client, entity, due date and days overdue

name: Segment & Prioritise Outstanding Balances
desc: Categorise outstanding AR by aging bucket, client risk, value and entity. Identify invoices requiring immediate attention (e.g., high risk balances)

name: Apply Cash Receipts
desc: Match and apply incoming payments to invoices in ERP

name: Import Bank Statement / Payment Data
desc: Automatically import daily bank statement or payment file into ERP for cash application processing.

name: Match Payments to Invoices
desc: Automatically match incoming payments to outstanding invoices using remittance advice, invoice number or client reference

name: Cash Application
desc: Automatically apply full or partial payments to invoices in ERP

name: Post Applied Cash in ERP
desc: Automatically post matched payment against invoice in AR sub-ledger, and update invoice status and AR aging accordingly.

name: Unapplied / Unallocated Cash Identified?
desc: Determine whether there are unmatched or partially applied payments
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 6.1.4 | No – proceed to 6.1.5

name: Investigate & Resolve Unallocated Cash
desc: Investigate any short payments, overpayments or unallocated cash. Resolve discrepancies, disputes or allocation issues. Apply or refund as appropriate. Document resolution in ERP.

name: Investigate Short / Over / Unmatched Payments
desc: Analyse unallocated cash to determine cause: short payment, overpayment, payment on account, wrong entity, or missing remittance detail.

name: Root Cause Investigation
desc: Reach out to client AP team or internal operations to obtain remittance details, correct allocation instructions or dispute information

name: Resolution Processing
desc: Apply corrections, reallocate payments or process refunds as required

name: Record Resolution
desc: Record resolution details and update transaction status in ERP

name: AR Reconciliation
desc: Reconcile AR subledger to GL and confirm balances. Identify and resolve any differences.

name: Reconcile AR Sub-Ledger to General Ledger
desc: Automatically compare AR sub-ledger balances to GL control account

name: Resolve Reconciliation Differences
desc: Identify, investigate and resolve any differences between AR sub-ledger and GL (e.g. timing differences, posting errors, FX adjustments)

name: Confirm AR Balance for Period Close
desc: Sign off AR balance as reconciled for month-end close. Provide reconciliation pack to central finance

name: Outreach & Escalation
desc: Proactive and structured client outreach for invoices approaching or past due date. Manage escalations to resolve issues and secure payment

name: Overdue Identification & Prioritisation
desc: Identify overdue receivables based on aging and payment terms. Prioritise accounts for collections outreach based on value, risk and aging

name: Overdue Receivables Identification
desc: Automatically identify invoices exceeding payment terms, and apply aging threshold rules (e.g. 30, 60, 90 days) to categorise severity

name: Collections Prioritisation
desc: Prioritise overdue accounts for collection effort automatically based on invoice value, client risk profile days overdue and collection history

name: Collections Outreach
desc: Contact clients regarding overdue invoices (e.g., reminders, follow-ups)

name: Automated Payment Reminder
desc: Automatically send system-generated payment reminder to client at defined overdue threshold (e.g. 7 days past due).

name: Follow-Up Contact (Email / Phone)
desc: Conduct follow-up outreach to client AP department via email or phone

name: Outreach Tracking Update
desc: Record outreach activity and outcome

name: Dispute Identified?
desc: Determine whether a dispute or billing query has been raised by the client
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 6.2.4 | No – proceed to 6.2.5

name: Dispute Management & Resolution
desc: Investigate and resolve billing disputes

name: Dispute Logging
desc: Record dispute details (dispute type, reason, disputed amount, supporting information) and categorisation (e.g., pricing, scope, quality, PO, compliance, etc.)

name: Dispute Investigation
desc: Investigate dispute with Client and internal teams (Client Services and Billing teams) as required. Review contract terms, deliverables and billing data.

name: Dispute Resolution Processing
desc: If dispute is valid, raise credit note or invoice adjustment. Post to AR and update revenue records accordingly.

name: Close Dispute & Update AR
desc: Mark dispute as resolved. Update AR record with resolution outcome. Resume normal collection if balance remains

name: Escalation Management
desc: Escalate overdue or high-risk receivables internally where required

name: Escalation Trigger Identification
desc: Identify accounts requiring escalation based on risk or overdue status

name: Internal Escalation Initiation
desc: Escalate accounts to internal stakeholders who hold client relationship (e.g., Client Services, Key Account Owner, etc.)

name: Escalation Outreach
desc: Execute escalation outreach to client

name: Document Escalation Outcome & Next Steps
desc: Record escalation outcome, agreed next actions and timeline

name: Payment Commitment Tracking
desc: Record and monitor client payment commitments

name: Payment Commitment Capture
desc: Capture client payment commitments and expected payment dates. Update AR and cash forecast.

name: Commitment Monitoring
desc: Monitor adherence to agreed payment commitments. Re-escalate if commitment is missed

name: Place Account on Credit Hold?
desc: Determine whether to suspend further project delivery or invoicing pending payment
outcomes: Yes – proceed to 6.2.8 | No – proceed to 6.2.5

name: Implement Credit Hold & Notify Teams
desc: Apply credit hold in ERP. Pause project activations and new order acceptance until resolved. Notify internal stakeholders (Operations, Finance)

name: Apply Credit Hold
desc: Set credit hold flag on client account in ERP. Block new project activations and invoicing until hold is resolved

name: Notify Project, Sales & Delivery Teams
desc: Notify internal stakeholders of credit hold status. Communicate implications for active and pipeline work.

name: Monitor for Resolution & Remove Hold
desc: Monitor for payment receipt or agreed resolution. Remove credit hold once conditions are met and notify teams

name: Cash Forecasting
desc: Forecast expected cash collections based on receivables, payment behavior, and client commitments

name: Forecast Update
desc: Refresh cash forecast with expected cash inflows based on outstanding receivables, aging and payment terms

name: AR & Cash Data Refresh
desc: Refresh AR balances, payment commitments and collection activity for cash forecasting

name: Direct Cash Forecast (Weekly)
desc: Generate weekly cash forecast based on AR, AP and known cash movements

name: Indirect Cash Forecast (Quarterly)
desc: Generate cash flow forecast based on revenue forecast and working capital assumptions

name: Variance Analysis vs Prior Forecast
desc: Compare actual cash receipts to prior forecast. Identify and explain material variances

name: Actual Cash Receipts Update
desc: Automatically update actual cash receipts in the forecast model for variance analysis

name: Direct Forecast Variance Analysis
desc: Compare actual cash receipts to weekly forecast and quantify variances by client, aging bucket and collection status

name: Indirect Forecast Variance Analysis
desc: Compare actual cash receipts to indirect forecast and quantify variances by forecast driver (e.g., revenue timing, DSO assumptions)

name: Investigate & Explain Material Variances
desc: Identify root cause of significant forecast-to-actual variances. Document explanations for reporting.

name: Forecast Reporting
desc: Prepare and present weekly cash forecast pack to central Finance. Include AR aging summary, collection risk flags and updated 13-week forecast

name: Direct Cash Forecast Reporting (Weekly)
desc: Prepare and review weekly cash forecast and actuals by client, aging bucket and collection status

name: Indirect Cash Forecast Reporting (Quarterly)
desc: Prepare cash flow forecast reporting including forecast, actuals and key drivers

name: Risk & Collections Issue Identification
desc: Report variances and highlight risks and collection issues by client/aging profile and driver/assumption

name: Submit Forecast to Central Finance / Treasury
desc: Submit cash forecast and reporting pack to central finance and treasury per group reporting calendar.

name: Project Close & Reporting
desc: All activities to formally close projects, capture financial and operational outcomes, report performance KPIs to executive leadership, and deliver contractual reporting obligations to clients

name: Project Close Activities
desc: Formally close the project from financial, contractual, and operational perspectives. Ensure all costs, revenues, and deliverables are reconciled and systems updated to reflect project completion.

name: Financial Close-Out
desc: Reconcile all project financials, confirm final revenue recognition, release or write off any remaining accruals and deferrals, and confirm the project cost ledger is complete and accurate.

name: Revenue & Cost Completion Check
desc: Confirm all revenue and costs have been recognised and posted

name: Billing Completion Check
desc: Confirm all invoices have been issued and processed

name: Open Items Resolution
desc: Identify and resolve outstanding items (e.g., unbilled time, unapplied cash, open POs)

name: Unbilled / Unposted Item Identification
desc: Identify outstanding time, expenses or costs

name: Release / Write-Off Accruals & Deferrals
desc: Review remaining accrued revenue, deferred revenue and cost accruals on the project. Release or reverse balances in ERP as appropriate

name: Outstanding Balance Resolution
desc: Resolve outstanding balances, adjustments or discrepancies. Obtain approval for any write-offs in line with delegation of authority. Post final journals.

name: Contract Compliance Review
desc: Verify all contractual obligations have been fulfilled and no outstanding amendments or change orders exist

name: Verify All Contractual Obligations Met
desc: Review contract terms against delivered scope. Confirm all deliverables, SLAs and obligations have been fulfilled

name: Confirm No Outstanding Amendments or Change Orders
desc: Check for any pending contract amendments, change orders or scope changes that require resolution before close

name: Closure Review
desc: Review project completion status and financials

name: Closure Approval
desc: Approve project closure

name: Project Status Update
desc: Update project status to closed in ERP / PSA

name: Project Closure Status Update
desc: Update project status to closed in PSA

name: Lock Time, Expense & Billing Entry
desc: Prevent further timecard submissions, expense claims and billing events against the closed project.

name: Financial Closure Status Update
desc: Update financial closure status in ERP

name: Closure Notification
desc: Notify relevant teams that project closure is complete

name: Archive Project Documentation
desc: Archive project records, contracts, invoices and supporting documentation per data retention policy.

name: Executive Insights & KPIs
desc: Generate and review project performance metrics and insights for management reporting and decision-making

name: Project Financial Summary
desc: Generate project-level financial summary including revenue, cost, margin and utilisation metrics.

name: Generate Project P&L Report
desc: Produce project profit and loss statement showing revenue, direct costs, indirect costs and margin

name: Calculate Margin & Utilisation Metrics
desc: Calculate project margin percentage, team utilisation, forecast accuracy and budget variance metrics

name: Client Reporting
desc: Prepare and deliver project reports and financial summaries to clients in line with contractual requirements

name: Client Report Preparation
desc: Prepare project and financial reports for client as per contractual requirements

name: Report Validation & Approval
desc: Validate report accuracy and approve for release

name: Report Distribution
desc: Deliver report to client via agreed distribution channels
